items.title: Anthropic launches $100M Claude Frontier Academy to train 10,000 engineers
items.summary_en: Anthropic is investing $100 million to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027, aiming at the enterprise AI talent gap. The programme follows a medical-residency model: initial in-person training, then a 12-week hands-on residency inside the participant's organization. Initial cohorts include firms such as Accenture, Deloitte, McKinsey and Morgan Stanley.

items.title: Barclays expands Claude deployment across its operations
items.summary_en: Barclays is widening its partnership with Anthropic and expects 50% of its developers to use Claude Code by end of 2026. Claude already powers its Colleague Knowledge Assistant (16,000+ employees) and helps process roughly 120,000 emails a day in Global Markets.
items.notes: Customer story published by Anthropic; figures are company-reported.

items.title: Anthropic introduces Claude Sonnet 5.5
items.summary_en: Anthropic's newsroom lists Claude Sonnet 5.5 as a clear upgrade over Sonnet 5, described as about 30% faster and up to 30% cheaper for most work.
items.notes: From the newsroom index only; the post itself could not be fetched.
